title: SPRec: Self-Play to Debias LLM-based Recommendation

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the over-recommendation of frequently exposed items using ORRatio (the proportion of results dominated by the top three recommended items), analyzing recommendation distributions across different popularity groups, and measuring output diversity via DivRatio.
Quantifying the distribution mismatch between the categories (e.g., genres) of recommended items and the user's historical interaction sequence using the Mismatch of Group Unfairness (MGU) metric.
